case_number: 2025 INSC 404; CIVIL APPEAL NO. OF 2025 (Arising out of S.L.P. (C) No. 26651 of 2023)
summary: Family dispute over maintenance and eviction; property ownership contested between parents and sons; Senior Citizens Act invoked for eviction; self-acquired property claim; maintenance already awarded by Family Court; interference by daughters in property transfers; co-ownership claim by son; Appellate Tribunal ordered eviction, High Court partially stayed; issue of son's right to residence despite torture and non-maintenance; reliance on Urmila Dixit case for Tribunal's eviction power; evidence of property transfers to daughters and son-in-law; younger daughter confirms gifts; other son supports eviction; dispute over exclusive ownership vs. 1/6th share claim.
legal_provisions_cited: Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act, 2007
Urmila Dixit vs. Sunil Sharan Dixit & Ors.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed in part; eviction of Krishna Kumar upheld; High Court's partial stay set aside; son's occupation restricted to shop and one room; Tribunal's directions on harassment and police monitoring reinstated.
